product.title: Private City Tour of San Francisco

description.text: Private San Francisco city tour with a dedicated driver-guide covering major neighborhoods, iconic landmarks, and waterfront viewpoints with flexible pacing for your group.

highlights: Private city tour with driver-guide and flexible pace
Golden Gate Bridge photo stop at vista point
Drive down Lombard Street when traffic allows
Stops around Coit Tower, Fisherman's Wharf, and Union Square
Waterfront drive along the Embarcadero with skyline and Bay Bridge views

start.description: San Francisco pickup at selected hotels or agreed central meeting point.

itineraryItems.title: Golden Gate Bridge
itineraryItems.description: Drive over the Golden Gate Bridge with a stop at a vista point for photos.

itineraryItems.title: Lombard Street
itineraryItems.description: Drive through Lombard Street for photos and city views, with a stop when conditions permit.

itineraryItems.title: Coit Tower
itineraryItems.description: See the Telegraph Hill landmark and surrounding city viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Fisherman's Wharf
itineraryItems.description: Drive through the waterfront district with time near Pier 39 and nearby attractions.

itineraryItems.title: Union Square
itineraryItems.description: Drive through Union Square and adjacent downtown shopping district.

itineraryItems.title: The Embarcadero
itineraryItems.description: Cruise along the Embarcadero for skyline and Bay Bridge views.

itineraryItems.title: Chinatown (pass-by)
itineraryItems.description: Drive through Chinatown with optional stop based on traffic and group preference.

faqs.question: How is pricing shown for this private tour?
faqs.answer: The listing starts from $305.00 per group (up to 3 travelers), with final pricing based on selected option and availability.

faqs.question: What landmarks are included on the route?
faqs.answer: Typical stops include Golden Gate Bridge, Lombard Street, Coit Tower, Fisherman's Wharf, Union Square, the Embarcadero, and a Chinatown pass-by segment.

faqs.question: Is cancellation available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before the experience start time.

additionalInfo: Private format with dedicated vehicle and driver-guide.
Reserve now and pay later may be available depending on selected option.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before start time.
